summary: Verified all three fixes end-to-end. (1)+(2) Booking Type UI redesign PASSES: no Hindi text in Booking Type section (no 'बुकिंग प्रकार' in DOM, all 9 card labels English-only), grid is 3 cols on desktop (1920px) and 2 cols on mobile (390px), all 9 labels fully readable — 'One Way', 'Round Trip', 'Multi-City', 'Hourly Charter', 'Daily Charter', 'Multi-Day', 'Group Booking', 'Emergency', 'Event Package' — NO truncation. data-testid='booking-type-{value}' present on all 9 cards. Selecting One Way highlights the card orange with CheckCircle and shows the English detail panel ('Single journey from A to B'). Group Booking is disabled with a 'Needs 5+ passengers' pill when passenger count < 5. (3) Payment gateway UI e2e PASSES: /customer/payment/paytest-inquiry-001 renders correctly (Booking Summary INQ-PAYTEST-001, Helicopter, 2 pax, pilgrimage, ₹45,000 = 50% advance). Clicking data-testid='pay-now-btn' redirects to checkout.stripe.com within 1s. Completed payment with Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 exp 12/34 CVC 123 ZIP 94103; Stripe redirected back to /payment/success within 2s. Success page renders confetti + '✅ Payment Successful! 🎉' + 'Amount Paid ₹45,000' + View Booking / Download Receipt / Go to Dashboard buttons. Backend confirmed via GET /api/payments/transactions/paytest-inquiry-001: payment_status='paid', paid_total=45000.0, transaction gateway='stripe_test', session_id matches Stripe checkout session. Regression: OTP still globally disabled — customer logs in with single Login button click, no Security Verification screen.

minor.issue: Returns an object with all fields null for the seeded inquiry paytest-inquiry-001 even after successful auth (customer role). Payment transactions endpoint works fine for the same id, so data exists — the inquiries GET endpoint is either using a different collection/lookup key or not populating fields. Non-blocking for this iteration since the payment flow doesn't depend on it, but worth checking.

issues: Bilingual clutter remains OUTSIDE the Booking Type section per user's Hinglish complaint: page still shows 'Complete Payment / भुगतान पूरा करें', 'Booking Summary / बुकिंग सारांश', 'Apply Loyalty Voucher / वाउचर लगाएं', 'Select Payment Method / भुगतान विधि चुनें', 'Remaining amount ... शेष राशि उड़ान से पहले देनी होगी'. Success page also mixes: 'भुगतान सफल — booking confirmed!' and 'Confirmation email aapko bhej diya gaya hai'. If the intent (per user feedback) is to eliminate Hindi where a language toggle exists, these hardcoded bilingual strings should also be dropped and driven by i18n like the rest of the app. Non-blocking — user only explicitly flagged the Booking Type step.
(carry-over from iteration_43) Departure Date and Pickup Time still use browser-native pickers instead of shadcn Calendar/Time components. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If user wants Hindi removed globally when language=English, remove hardcoded 'Complete Payment / भुगतान पूरा करें', 'Booking Summary / बुकिंग सारांश', etc. on PaymentPage.js and PaymentSuccessPage.js (mirror the Booking Type cleanup).
OPTIONAL (minor): Investigate why GET /api/inquiries/paytest-inquiry-001 returns nulls for a customer that clearly owns the inquiry (payment flow found it fine).
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentPage.js and PaymentSuccessPage.js hardcode bilingual 'English / हिंदी' labels while the rest of the app uses i18n — same anti-pattern that the user just complained about in Booking Type. Consider routing all of these through i18n keys so the language toggle actually controls them.

Payment was completed during this test, so the inquiry is now in payment_status='paid' with 50% advance of ₹45,000 recorded (session cs_test_a1x845jeFaRwTvnGv7X2F5JmFgA7bQ3JBQujI7...). Main agent should re-seed if further payment testing is needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Booking Type UI redesign and Stripe payment e2e both verified. The paytest-inquiry-001 inquiry is NOW PAID — if you need to re-test payment initiation, ask main agent to re-seed or use a different inquiry_id. Stripe checkout requires a ZIP (billingPostalCode) in addition to card/expiry/CVC/name — Playwright must fill input#billingPostalCode='94103' or Pay button silently no-ops. The '← Back to Inquiry Status' link on PaymentPage points to a customer inquiry-detail route; that route was not explicitly tested here.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found in the requested scope. All three items work as claimed by the main agent.
